row.evidence: Breezy's Okta article says the Okta/Breezy HR SAML integration supports IdP-initiated SSO and JIT (Just In Time) provisioning, SSO is available only on Pro plans, and a help-centre search for SCIM returns no articles.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to none (by absence). June recorded Pro as the SCIM plan, but no first-party page documents SCIM: SAML SSO with JIT provisioning (Okta, OneLogin, Google, generic SAML) is the only automated provisioning, and it is on the Custom Pro Plan (Contact Us). The June 'SCIM on Pro' claim is dropped. Prices unchanged: Bootstrap free, Startup $157/mo, Growth $273/mo, Business $439/mo billed annually ($189/$329/$529 monthly), flat per company with unlimited users. The public API covers positions and candidates; it has no endpoints to create, update or remove company users, and API Access is an optional add-on on Pro.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per 60-second interval per user token.

limitations.text: The public API (positions, candidates, webhooks) has no endpoints to create, update or remove company users; API Access is an optional add-on on the Custom Pro Plan.

user_api.notes: available=false: the complete endpoint index (llms.txt) has no user-management write endpoints; only read-only /user and /user/details.

okta.notes: Okta app lists SAML only; Breezy says it supports IdP-initiated SSO and JIT.

google.notes: Breezy documents Google Workspace SAML setup; Google's own catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: From Breezy's own OneLogin guide; OneLogin's catalogue blocks bots.

fallbacks.other_sync: Employee auto-join link by email domain; HRIS integrations listed on Business (direction not documented)
